overlaps.rationale: Renewal extends validity; validity period is the time span during which a document or service remains valid.
Opening hours describe when a service operates, not the validity duration of a service document.
Duration is a general length of time, whereas validity period specifically concerns how long a service document remains valid.
Expiry date is a specific cutoff date for packaged food, not the validity period of a service document.
Probation period is an employment trial period, distinct from the validity period of a service document.
